draft:
Why Business Schools Must Embrace AI

In today's rapidly evolving world, artificial intelligence is transforming every industry. Business schools cannot afford to ignore this paradigm shift. It's not just a technological change — it's a fundamental reimagining of how we prepare leaders.

Many students feel that their curriculum is outdated. Numerous employers have expressed concern that graduates lack the skills needed to navigate the complexities of an AI-driven economy. Studies show that a significant percentage of jobs will be impacted.

Business schools should leverage cutting-edge tools to empower students. They should foster a culture of innovation and embrace the opportunities that AI presents. Faculty must be incentivized to update their courses.

The time to act is now. If we fail to adapt, we risk becoming irrelevant. The future of business education depends on our ability to harness the power of AI and drive meaningful change.
